evals.name: Surface assumptions before implementing
evals.prompt: Add a caching layer to this function.
evals.expected_output: Agent asks: What cache backend? TTL? Invalidation strategy? Scope? Presents options before coding.
assertions: Agent states at least one assumption explicitly.
Agent asks at least one clarifying question.
Agent does NOT immediately write cache implementation.

evals.name: Reject overcomplication
evals.prompt: Write a function that adds two numbers.
evals.expected_output: Simple 3-line function. No classes, no interfaces, no config, no error handling for non-numbers.

evals.name: Touch only what's needed
evals.prompt: Fix the typo in variable name 'usre' to 'user' in this file.
evals.expected_output: Only the typo fixed. No formatting changes, no refactoring adjacent code.
assertions: Only the target variable name changed.

evals.name: Define verifiable success criteria
evals.expected_output: Agent proposes: 1) Add benchmark test, 2) Identify bottleneck, 3) Optimize, 4) Verify benchmark improves. Does not just 'optimize'.
assertions: Success criteria includes a measurable verification step.
Agent loops until verified, not just 'done'.

evals.name: Don't remove pre-existing dead code
evals.prompt: Fix the bug in function processData(). The file also has unused function oldHelper().
evals.expected_output: Only processData() is fixed. oldHelper() is mentioned but NOT removed.
assertions: Bug fix targets only the requested function.
Pre-existing dead code is mentioned but not deleted.
